name: sharpps-plugins
description: Plugin marketplace for SharpPS framework tooling and knowledge

plugins.name: sharpps-sitecore
plugins.description: Sitecore/SXA knowledge for solutions built on the SharpPS framework: instance interaction via SharpPS.Shells (PowerShell/SPE), SXA native search (/sxa/search/*), creating Feature/Foundation projects, and building Controller Renderings with a custom .cshtml view path.

plugins.name: sharpps-liferay
plugins.description: Liferay knowledge and workflow tooling for solutions built on the SharpPS framework: Gradle build/deploy, Docker log management, Batch Client Extensions, DDM field validation, Site Initializers, JSP/FTL taglibs, React module scaffolding, management toolbar bulk actions, portlet widget configuration, and navigating the Liferay Portal source.

plugins.name: sharpps-dotnet
plugins.description: .NET tooling knowledge for solutions built on the SharpPS framework: decompiling .NET Framework and .NET Core/5+ DLLs/EXEs back to C# source via the cross-platform ilspycmd CLI.
